patches_modified.description: Patch-time AMOLED dark theme (issue #21): rewrites Brave dark chrome surfaces to pure black (or a custom opaque hex). patches_added.name: Disable HDR Video Playback

patches_modified.description: Downloads the original Photo Mode CDN assets instead of keeping TikTok's rendered copies when enabled.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: SIM spoof
patches_modified.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_modified.name: Theme engine
patches_modified.description: Experimental recovery opt-in: runtime-selectable BlueIT themes applied to TikTok TUX/Compose colors and classic surfaces.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.

patches_modified.name: Hide video overlays
patches_modified.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the LIVE entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar, on the feed and on videos opened from a profile, a hashtag, a sound or search. The status bar can also be hidden only while a LIVE room is open. Separate switches hide the Full screen button, location labels, the effect, template and CapCut tags above descriptions, and the Report button some regions get above the creator's picture, without removing videos or changing location permissions. One more takes the Add comment bar off those opened videos so they fill the screen, and another clears the close button, progress bar and pause and speed buttons Clear display leaves at the bottom. Switches: Hushfeed settings > Feed screen, and App for the status bar.
